description: Meguiar's Soft Buff Rotary Backing Plate is designed for our 7" and 8" Soft Buff rotary pads. This backing plate's self-centering system guarantees pad balance, resulting in excellent performance and balance during use. Features long-lasting one-piece molded construction and a hook and loop attachment system that allows for quick and easy pad changes. Use this WRBP Rotary Backing Plate for a faster cut and firmer backing plate support (or use the WRSBP Rotary Soft Backing Plate for more conformability over contours and minimal swirling). Intended to be used with rotary polisher with 5/8" diameter shaft.
